title: Follow up qa-v1-theory-425eec69d347067a2b530ba3
behavioral_concerns: follow up: Implementation identity drift during QA sharding may be missed, allowing evidence to be bound to a stale fingerprint

evidence.summary: buildQAEvidencePublication freezes plan with stale qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint while ExpectedTargetID is fresh; no equality check before plan creation
RunQAInvestigation validates targetBefore vs ExpectedTargetID only, not vs plan ImplementationFingerprint; target drift after sharding yields stale binding

theories.claim: Implementation identity drift occurring during an individual shard’s read-only investigation is always detected and blocks that shard
theories.basis: runOneQAShard captures before = targetIdentity(target) and rejects if before != qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint with QAErrorStaleInput before runtime, then captures after after runtime and rejects if after != before with QAErrorPermissionDenied implementation identity drift, and revalidates governed inputs via validateCurrentQAMap both before runtime (804) and after runtime (845) before persisting any theory
theories.confirmation_condition: A drift where before!=map or after!=before would still persist a QAShard with PhaseCompleted and Theory.ImplementationFingerprint == stale before value
theories.refutation_condition: Code shows explicit before != map check at qa.go:824 returning stale_input, explicit after != before check at qa.go:841-845 returning permission_denied with StopReason implementation identity drift and appending the attempt, plus governed-input drift revalidation at 844 and 939-940, and existing test coverage rejects drift
theories.inconclusive_condition: A runtime fence or custom Service.WithQAMapFence in tests could bypass the identity check, making static conclusion incomplete
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read runOneQAShard before/after blocks, validateCurrentQAMap calls, and qa_test.go TestQAPermissionRejectsFallbackAndTargetDrift which mutates target during Run and expects PermissionDenied; verify no code path skips these checks for concurrent workers

theories.outcome_reason: Per-shard inspection shows dual targetIdentity checks and map revalidation surrounding every runtime invocation; concurrent workers in runQAShardBatch each execute the same per-shard checks sequentially per worker, so intra-shard drift is not missed and is persisted as Blocked with blocker category permission_denied, contrary to concern for this window

theories.claim: Evidence publication can bind results to a stale implementation fingerprint if the target drifts after sharding completes but before evidence plans are frozen
theories.basis: buildQAEvidencePublication captures a fresh pprocess.IdentifyTree digest as ExpectedTargetID but freezes each QAEvidencePlan with the stale qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint without comparing them; RunQAInvestigation validates targetBefore.Digest == ExpectedTargetID (fresh) not vs plan fingerprint; ValidateQAEvidence only checks record equality to plan and TargetIdentityBefore == TargetIdentityAfter, never that TargetIdentityBefore == ImplementationFingerprint
theories.confirmation_condition: Code inspection shows no comparison between fresh pprocess.IdentifyTree digest and qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint before FreezeQAEvidencePlan, and ValidateQAEvidence does not require TargetIdentityBefore == ImplementationFingerprint, allowing a record with ImplementationFingerprint=A and TargetIdentityBefore=B to validate
theories.refutation_condition: A guard compares fresh target identity to qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint and aborts evidence publication on mismatch, or ValidateQAEvidence rejects records where TargetIdentityBefore != ImplementationFingerprint, or buildQAEvidencePublication re-validates the map via validateCurrentQAMap before freezing
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot determine without executing a drift simulation if an alternate process runner alias makes IdentifyTree and targetIdentity diverge in a way masks the mismatch
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only search for ImplementationFingerprint equality checks in qa.go buildQAEvidencePublication, qa_investigation.go RunQAInvestigation ExpectedTargetID handling, and qa_evidence.go ValidateQAEvidence fingerprint checks; confirm absence of cross-check
